title: Low-temperature low-humidity pretreatment followed by RF heating: a novel method of fig preservation
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, 4,521-532
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00304K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Irengbam Barun Mangang, A. Vidhya Lakshmi, N. Venkatachalapathy, M. Loganathan
100% mortality can be achieved using RF at electrode heights of 180, 200 and 220 mm for all the time ranges studied. LTLH pretreatment followed by RF heating of figs at 180 mm and conveyor speed of 5 m h−1 is suitable for functional quality retention.
